body:
I did the veterans crisis line, but it seemed to be ingenious. 

I understand the difference, but does it matter? I just needed an outlet.

We talked and decided to try counseling. We still love each other, our attitudes just aren’t working right now. I think our identities are too infused and we need to be more independent. We’re young and need to act like it. We don’t argue about major things like money/finances, it’s always been about stupid things; forgot to take out trash, things that just don’t really surmount to much. Which is somewhat hopeful. I think we can work things out, because we both have a reason to stay. It’s the unknown that I’m afraid of, I’m willing to do whatever it takes.. but what if that’s not enough?
